title: cs daily scratchpad - QBRs & renewals
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick notes for account follow-ups and QBR prep

TODAY (Tue) - top priorities:
- Finalize Acme Corp QBR slides + send 24-hr preread (slides in drive: Conf link above). Priya to review metrics slide by EOD.
- Renewal outreach: Nimbus Health (renewal 2026-04-15) -> need updated usage + exec deck. Book 30m with Exec Sponsor (Daniel) this week.
- Support follow-up: Polaris ticket CS-1749 (embedding regressions) -> engineering triage scheduled Wed 10am PT. Confirm owner and ETA; reply to customer with mitigations.

ACCOUNTS TO TOUCH (quick status):
- Acme Corp (Enterprise): QBR 2026-04-07. Usage up 12% q/q, cost spike on LLM inference last week (see billing notes). Action: add cost mitigation recommendations (batching + quantization) to slides.
- Nimbus Health (Renewal): currently on Dedicated trial. Risk: low activity in two products. Ask Solutions Eng for adoption playbook + product checklist.
- Orion Analytics (Support): on-hosted API, reported latency increase 3/28-3/29. Support ticket escalated; need postmortem draft + customer-facing summary.
- Zephyr Media (Expansion): asking about private deployment for HIPAA. Collect compliance checklist + KMS options.

MEETING PREP / TO-DOs:
- QBR slides: update SLA/Reliability page with last 3 months p95 latency (ask Observability for trace link).
- Exec summary: 3 bullets (usage, risks, asks). Keep under 200 words.
- Reports: export last 90d tokens & cost by model for Acme and Nimbus. Ask Finance: CS-data-export ticket -> JIRA-CS-4512.
- Action owner names inline in slide notes.

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep QBR deck to 12 slides max. Include 1-pg appendix with technical notes.
- When emailing preread: subject = "Acme QBR preread + asks (Apr 7)"; include meeting objectives and two decisions we want.
- Follow-up cadence for renewals: outreach 6 weeks prior, then 3w, 1w, 3d.

OPEN QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS:
- Need final numbers for cost-saving estimate from Optimize team (who owns this? ping SRE/optimize).
- Legal approval timeline for HIPAA template for Zephyr. Who on Legal is point? (CC: @Maya Patel)

QUICK CALLS / SLOTS:
- Wed 9:30am PT: internal QBR dry run (Priya + Leo).
- Thu 2:00pm PT: Acme preread sync with Solutions Eng (Leo).

NEXT ACTIONS (today):
1) Send Acme preread draft to Priya by 3pm.
2) Open renewal playbook request for Nimbus (assign to Leo).
3) Reply to Polaris ticket with ETA and interim workaround.
4) Ping Optimize for cost estimate (Slack in #optimize-team).

RANDOM NOTES / snippets:
- Possible slide: "Cost reduction playbook" bullets: batching heuristics, prefix caching, model variant fallback, quantization guide.
- Reminder: attach CS case numbers to calendar invites for traceability.

---
End of scratchpad (will tidy into formal QBR doc tomorrow).
